Outside the queue

Career

Experience and certifications

Three roles, each one closer to the platform. in total.

  1. May 2025 – Present

    Cloud Support Associate (Netskope)

    Aurovalor Consultancy, Bangalore, India

    • Own and resolve high-severity cases across Netskope Client, Private Access (NPA), Explicit Proxy, and DLP — live support to enterprise customers over calls and chat.
    • Troubleshoot complex network and security issues involving DNS, EDNS, SSL/TLS, HTTPS, and secure traffic forwarding across multi-vendor environments.
    • Analyse packet captures in Wireshark to find root causes of connectivity and security problems, sharing clear remediation steps with customers.
    • Design and fine-tune DLP detection rules using RE2 regular expressions; act as the team's Netskope DLP specialist.
    • Partner with engineering and operations teams to convert temporary workarounds into permanent fixes and product improvements.
    • Guide customers step by step through configuration changes and production rollouts, reducing downtime risk during go-live.
